content_zh: 粉红票投票全攻略亲爱的大家，《大汉嫣华》二月即将参加pk。需大量粉红票票支援。关于粉红票，可能大家并不是很清楚，所以某江在此做一个详细解说。2009年，女频将pk票和女频月票合并为粉红票。一：粉红票使用方式1.粉红票兼具pk票和月票双重属性，但是单张粉红票只可在当月pk作品和当月月票竞逐作品中择一而投；也就是说，在女频中，单以一张粉红票而言，你可以选择投给一本pk书支持它pk，也可以投给一本上架的书【包括包月和单订书】支持它的月票争夺战。但是一个月，你可以拥有不止一张粉红票而自由支配它们。比如说，用户a连续包月三个月，到二月正好是第四个月，于是她将有三张粉红票。她可以将两张投给某江即将pk的这本《大汉嫣华》，而将第三张投给月票榜上的某本书。2.用户每月获得的粉红票，必须在当月内使用，过期作废。唔，关于这点的解说，我只是猜测。就是粉红票以自然月为分界线，一月获得的粉红票只有在一月使用，到二月将作废。因此，想要单订或者包月支持《大汉嫣华》的朋友，请在二月一日凌晨之后再消费。某江鞠躬大家。二.粉红票获得途径：1.每位新包月用户（自然人）每月获得粉红票一张；2.连续包月三个月以上没有间断的用户，第四个月起继续连续包月可获得三张粉红票（如中间曾停止包月，则全部重新计算）；以上两条和从前女频的pk票规则一样。包月指的是在花费一个固定值后，一个月里可以任意浏览起点包月书库里所有的书。如果你是刚开始包月，则每个月有一张粉红票，如果你已经连续包了三个月，从第四个包月起，你将拥有三张粉红票。据说女频如今是包月满90天以上，则第91天将有三张粉红票，所以也可能出现月初一张粉红票，月末三张粉红票的现象。每一张粉红票都是稀缺的资源。古人教育我们：谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦。还请大家多多留意，切勿浪费哦。还有一点我们要特别提出来注意：如果你希望一直包月拥有三张粉红票的话，请自己在包月期限结束前续包月，如果选择起点个人书屋中那个自动续包月功能，则它很有可能在前一天断包月后，第二天再为你续包下一次包月，所以中间有一个时间差，也就是说，你将在下个三个月中不能再拥有三张粉红票，继续支持你心爱的作者。3.自2008年12月29日起，所有订阅女频单订库作品的用户，在女频单订书库消费满8元即可获得粉红票一张，在此基础上，额外消费满5元即再可获得粉红票一张，依次累计。这一点是粉红票政策最大的改革。也就是说，从09年元旦开始，单订用户也可以支持pk了。而这种方法得粉红票的张数无上限。注意，这个单订订书的范围，只有女频单订书库里的单订上架书或是包月书库中已经上架满三个月的书。至于主站的vip书以及女频早年在主站上架的书则不在这个范围。请大家一定要注意，免得花钱订了书却还是得不到粉红票支持想支持的作者。当然，这两种方法你可以使用。也就是说一个月里，你可以又包月又单订。得到的粉红票将累加。三：我们总是希望花最少的钱支持作者。下面，我们从价格方面来衡量下三种得到粉红票的方法：初始包月，满三月包月，以及单订得票。首先建议大家去淘宝购买起点点币，应该能打到6折。包月的价格是十五元一个月，高级vip的话八折优惠后为十二元。起点长期活动有包三个月送一个月的活动。于是初级vip包月平均成本6.75元。高级vip包月平均成本5.4元。若为初始包月，一个月只有一张粉红票，则每张票的成本是初级vip6.75元，高级vip5.4元。若包月已经满三个月，则一个月有三张粉红票，则每张票的成本是：初级vip2.25元，高级vip1.8元。至于单订，第一张8元的粉红票成本是4.8元。之后的每张票的成本是3元。包月和单订各有好处，也各有不足，大家可以斟酌自己的喜好以及喜欢的书来决定。大体是说，如果包月书库中你看的书多，则可以选择包月，否则可以选择单订，事实上，大多数包月书库的书也是支持单订的【新上架的包月书三月内不支持单订，其余都支持。】但是，如果单以得粉红票支持作者论，那么显然，满三月包月用户花费小于单订用户小于初始包月用户。因此，除非你是资深包月人士，某江推荐你进行单订。四：推荐单订书库里的好书，以供单订用户参考邹邹：《幺妹》邹邹的文风很紧凑，此文阶级很种田，有兄妹恋擦边。鱼易雨：《古代育儿宝典》单订榜第一，题材很讨好，文字质朴，但是情节不错。无敌大南瓜：《无尽相思风》很可爱的青梅竹马，看的人心里甜甜的。吱吱：《穿越以和为贵》不会yy的天马行宫，情节编撰合理。冬雪晚晴：《红楼遗梦》拓拔荆荆：《灵异女道士》伊莲：《锁寒窗》下面的则是包月书库中的比较老的好文，供纯单订用户参考。首先是某江的第一本旧作《金屋恨》。灯火阑珊：《金枝玉叶》老庄墨韩：《小楼传说》柳暗花溟：《驱魔人2》《神仙也有江湖》va：《平凡的清穿日子》沐非：《宸宫》，《帝锦》月裹鸿声：《飞花青离之刺客传奇》，《素手遮天》禾早：《猫游记》《江湖遍地卖装备》泥巴人：《翻手男覆手女》秦十六：《十样锦》扫雪煮酒：《明朝五好家庭》《满堂娇》五：《大汉嫣华》从二月一日中午十二点开始pk，某江拜求大家粉红粉红的票票支持，将二月堆成一个粉红的春天吧。将按粉红票加更，章程二月一号再订。亲亲大家。
content_en: Complete pink vote voting guide Dear everyone, "The Great Han Yanhua" will participate in PK in February. A large number of pink tickets are needed to support this. Maybe everyone is not very clear about pink tickets, so Jiang will give a detailed explanation here. In 2009, Female Channel merged PK tickets and Female Channel monthly tickets into pink tickets. 1: How to use pink tickets 1. Pink tickets have the dual attributes of PK tickets and monthly tickets, but a single pink ticket can only be voted on one of the PK works of the month and the monthly ticket competition works of the month; that is to say, in the female channel, for a single pink ticket, you can choose to vote for a PK book to support its PK, or you can vote for a book on the shelf [including monthly subscription and single subscription books] to support its monthly ticket competition. But for a month, you can have more than one pink ticket and use them freely. For example, user A has been subscribing for three consecutive months, and February is exactly the fourth month, so she will have three pink tickets. She can vote two for the book "The Great Han Yanhua" that Jiang is about to PK, and vote the third for a certain book on the monthly voting list. 2. The pink tickets obtained by users every month must be used within the month and will become invalid upon expiration. Well, I'm just guessing at this point. That is, pink tickets are divided into natural months. Pink tickets obtained in January can only be used in January and will be invalid in February. Therefore, if you want to support "Han Yanhua" with a single order or a monthly subscription, please make your purchase after the early morning of February 1st. Jiang bowed to everyone. 2. Ways to obtain pink tickets: 1. Each new monthly user (natural person) will receive one pink ticket per month; 2. Users who have continued monthly subscription for more than three months without interruption can obtain three pink tickets starting from the fourth month (if the monthly subscription is stopped in the middle, all will be recalculated); the above two are the same as the previous PK ticket rules for female channels. The monthly subscription means that after spending a fixed amount, you can browse all the books in the Qidian monthly subscription library at will for a month. If you just started the monthly subscription, you will have one pink ticket every month. If you have subscribed for three consecutive months, you will have three pink tickets starting from the fourth monthly subscription. It is said that if a female channel has a monthly subscription of more than 90 days, there will be three pink tickets on the 91st day, so there may be one pink ticket at the beginning of the month and three pink tickets at the end of the month. Every pink ticket is a scarce resource. The ancients taught us: Who knows that every grain of food on the plate is hard work? Please also pay attention and don’t waste it. There is another point that we would like to pay special attention to: if you want to always have three pink tickets on a monthly subscription, please renew your monthly subscription before the end of the monthly subscription period. If you choose the automatic monthly subscription renewal function in the Qidian Personal Bookstore, it is very likely that it will renew your monthly subscription for you the next day after the monthly subscription is discontinued one day, so there is a time lag in the middle. That is to say, you will no longer be able to have three pink tickets in the next three months and continue to support your beloved author. 3. Starting from December 29, 2008, all users who subscribe to the female channel's single subscription library can get a pink ticket when they spend 8 yuan or more in the female channel's single subscription library. On this basis, if they spend an additional 5 yuan or more, they can get another pink ticket, and the accumulation is in sequence. This is the biggest reform of the pink vote policy. In other words, starting from New Year's Day 2009, single-order users can also support pk. There is no upper limit to the number of pink tickets you can get using this method. Note that the scope of this single order book only covers single order books in the female channel's single order library or books that have been on the shelf for three months in the monthly subscription library. As for the VIP books on the main website and the books published by female channels on the main website in the early years, they are not within this scope. Please be careful, so as not to spend money to order a book but still not get the pink ticket to support the author you want to support. Of course, you can use both methods. That is to say, within a month, you can have both monthly subscription and single order. The pink tickets obtained will be accumulated. Three: We always hope to spend the least amount of money to support the author. Below, we measure the three ways to get pink tickets in terms of price: initial monthly subscription, monthly subscription for three months, and individual tickets. First of all, I suggest you go to Taobao to buy Qidian Point coins, you should be able to get a 40% discount. The monthly subscription price is fifteen yuan a month, and for senior VIP, the price is twelve yuan after a 20% discount. Qidian’s long-term activity includes a three-month package with one month free. Therefore, the average monthly cost of entry-level VIP subscription is 6.75 yuan. The average monthly cost of premium VIP is 5.4 yuan. If it is an initial monthly subscription and there is only one pink ticket per month, the cost of each ticket is 6.75 yuan for junior VIP and 5 yuan for advanced VIP..4 yuan. If the monthly subscription has been three months, there are three pink tickets in one month, and the cost of each ticket is: 2.25 yuan for junior VIP and 1.8 yuan for advanced VIP. As for individual orders, the cost of the first 8 yuan pink ticket is 4.8 yuan. The cost of each subsequent ticket is $3. Both monthly subscription and individual subscription have advantages and disadvantages. You can decide based on your own preferences and favorite books. Generally speaking, if you read a lot of books in the monthly subscription library, you can choose monthly subscription, otherwise you can choose single ordering. In fact, most books in the monthly subscription library also support individual ordering [Newly launched monthly subscription books do not support individual ordering within three months, but the rest do. 】However, if the pink vote alone supports the author theory, then it is obvious that the cost of monthly subscription users for three months is less than that of single-subscription users and that of initial monthly subscription users. Therefore, unless you are an experienced monthly subscription user, I recommend you to make a single order. Four: Recommend good books in the single-order book library for reference by single-order users. Zou Zou: "Yao Mei" Zou Zou's writing style is very compact. The class of this article is very farming, and there are brothers and sisters who love each other. Yu Yiyu: "Ancient Parenting Manual" ranks first in the single-order list. The subject matter is very pleasing, the text is simple, but the plot is good. The Invincible Pumpkin: "Endless Lovesickness" is a very cute childhood sweetheart, which makes people feel sweet in their hearts when watching it. Zhizhi: "Peace is the most precious thing in time travel" is not a yyy Pegasus Palace, and the plot is well-written. Winter Snow and Wanqing: "The Lost Dream in Red Mansions": "Unleashing the Thorns": "The Supernatural Female Taoist Priest" Elaine: "Lock the Cold Window" The following are older and good articles in the monthly subscription library for reference by pure subscription users. The first is Jiang's first old work "The Hate of the Golden House". Dim lights: "Golden Branches and Jade Leaves" Lao Zhuang Mohan: "The Legend of the Little House" Hua Ming: "The Exorcist 2" "The Immortals Also Have Jianghu" va: "Ordinary Qingchuan Days" Mu Fei: "Chen Palace", "Emperor Brocade" Yue Wan Hongsheng: "The Legend of the Assassin Flying Flowers Qingli", "Covering the Sky with Plain Hands" He Zao: "Cat Travels" "Jiang "Selling equipment all over the lake" Mud Man: "The man who flips his hands and the woman who flips his hands" Qin Shiliu: "Ten Kinds of Brocade" Sweeping Snow and Cooking Wine: "Five Good Families of the Ming Dynasty" "Man Tang Jiao" Five: "The Great Han Yanhua" will start pk from 12 noon on February 1st. Please support everyone's pink votes to turn February into a pink spring. Additional updates will be made according to the pink ticket, and the charter will be booked again on February 1st.
